caption: "is spotify down" — 100,000+ searches this week. Yes, it was, on September 29.

Why: Just after 9:30 a.m. ET, Spotify's apps started failing with "Something went wrong." Downdetector got over 200,000 reports from 173 countries, more than 100,000 from the US. At the peak it logged 3,000 reports a minute; a normal day brings 2. Spotify said it was fixed at 3:14 p.m. ET and has not named a cause.
What most people don't know: the music mostly kept playing. What broke was sign-in, search and browsing. Some people who logged out could not log back in.
Very simply put: in an outage, don't press log out.

slides.headline: Spotify went down. Some who logged out couldn't get *back in*.
slides.sub: 10 things most people don't know about the Spotify outage, searched 100,000+ times in the US this week.
